newsitem.title: USA: Williams Scotsman Inc to redeem outstanding debt.
newsitem.headline: Williams Scotsman Inc to redeem outstanding debt.

text.p: Williams Scotsman Inc will pay 104.83 percent for each its 9-1/2 percent senior secured notes due 2000 and 107.36 percent for each of its 11 percent senior notes due 2004 in a recapitalization of the company, the company said late on Monday.
Outstanding 9-1/2 percent notes total $165 million and outstanding 11 percent notes total $29.3 million.

In April, private buyout firms The Cypress Group and Keystone Inc said they signed a definitive agreement to buy about 90 percent of privately-held Scotsman Holdings Inc for $675 million, including the assumption of debt.
Scotsman is the parent company of Williams Scotsman, the nation's second-largest lessor of mobile office units.
